report.clinical_summary: Patient has been on Biktarvy for 18 months with undetectable viral load for 6 months. They report persistent foot pain (burning sensation, doesn't improve with rest), fatigue, and morning GI symptoms (nausea, fullness, difficulty swallowing). They've had to cut back on work tasks and social activities, and their life has become centered around rest. They're uncertain about the cause of symptoms, worried about long-term effects, and experiencing irritability and sleep disturbances. They're actively trying self-care strategies (regular sleep, gentle stretching, smaller meals, meditation) but seeing limited relief.
